trades.name: True gap up which holds (above today's high)
trades.quote: The cleanest scenario is a true gap up on both ES and NQ which is a long as long as it sustains a cash hours back test.
trades.stop_hint: as long as it sustains a cash hours back test.

trades.name: Failed break of 3-day balance high 7298-7302
trades.quote: I am a bit more willing to short ES on a failed break of its 3-day range than I am shorting NQ but NQ is fully capable of catching down quickly if for some reason it flips to relative weakness.

trades.name: Strength above 7288-7289
trades.quote: Given bearish setups have no recently produced bearish results, and as of now this is a potential ETH LAAF of the 3-day balance high, I am still somewhat willing to be long strength above 7288-7289 at least for a retest.

trades.name: Weakness below 7288-7289
trades.quote: If we see weakness below 7288-7289 I may be willing to join a downtrend the short side. However, if sellers fail to get through 69-74 and today’s low my plan will be to panic cover and flip long.
trades.stop_hint: if sellers fail to get through 69-74 and today’s low my plan will be to panic cover and flip long.

trades.name: Hold of 7269-7274
trades.quote: Given the above, I’m okay taking a long on any failure from sellers to get through today’s low with traction. Perhaps 69-74 holds again or perhaps we get a LBAF of today’s low.

trades.name: LBAF of today's low
trades.quote: Given the above, I’m okay taking a long on any failure from sellers to get through today’s low with traction. Perhaps 69-74 holds again or perhaps we get a LBAF of today’s low.

trades.name: True gap up and go above today's high (28188)
trades.quote: As mentioned above, a true gap up and go (above today’s high) is the cleanest scenario.

trades.name: Hold of 28151-28169
trades.quote: I will consider a long if 151-169 holds but know that today’s 188 high must reclaim for it to be any good.
trades.stop_hint: know that today’s 188 high must reclaim for it to be any good.

trades.name: 28151-28169 flips to firm resistance
trades.quote: I don’t love the idea of being short NQ, but if 151-169 flips to firm resistance it probably sees 081-098 now that its APBL was tested afterhours.

trades.name: LBAF of APBL 28108.75
trades.quote: If we get a LBAF of 108.75 I could see that producing a trip to 151-169 and then monitor for continuation from there.
